finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: Entering a malicious filename that contains shell metacharacters
finding.assumptions: The filenames provided by the user are directly used to open files without any validation or sanitization.

parsed.refutation_attempt: Checked the code for any invocation of a shell or exec-family function using the user-supplied filename. The only operations on the filename are passed to std::ifstream::open at lines 25 and 46. std::ifstream::open simply opens a file on the filesystem and does not spawn a shell or execute a command. Therefore, no OS command injection is possible from user-controlled input in this context.
